title: ¿Podría…? Pedir con educación
goal: a pedir favores y permiso con Could you…? y Could I…? y a contestar con amabilidad

ex.t: Could you help me with my suitcase?
Could I use your phone, please?
Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
Could you spell your surname, please?
— Could you wait a minute? — Of course.
I'm sorry, I can't. I'm at the doctor's.
ex.es: Lo siento, no puedo. Estoy en el médico.

ex.t: Please record your message after the beep.
ex.es: Grabe su mensaje después de la señal, por favor.

ex.t: Leave a message after the beep.
ex.es: Deje un mensaje después de la señal.

pron.title: La voz amable de Could you…?
pron.tip: Could suena «cud» (la l no se pronuncia) y Could you se une: «cúdyu». Para sonar amable, sube un poco la voz al final de la pregunta.

falseFriend.tip: Recordar es remember: I remember your number. Record es grabar: record a message.

exercises.q: ___ you help me with my suitcase, please?
exercises.why: Para pedir un favor con educación: Could you…?
Detrás de could, el verbo va sin to y sin -ing.
A Could you…? se contesta Of course / Sure, no con could.

exercises.q: Please ___ your message after the beep.

exercises.why: Could + verbo sin to: Could you spell…?
Repeat necesita un objeto: repeat that.

exercises.q: — Could you drive me to the station? — I'm ___, I can't.
exercises.why: Para decir que no, suaviza: I'm sorry, I can't.

answer: Could you give me your number?
Could you give me your number, please?
Could you give me your number please?
Could you please give me your number?
exercises.why: El imperativo suena brusco; Could you…? es amable.

answer: Could I leave a message, please?
Could I leave a message please?

exercises.q: Could she calls me back after lunch?
exercises.why: Could es igual para todos y el verbo nunca lleva -s: Could she call…?

exercises.q: I always record my son's birthday.

exercises.why: Con could el verbo no cambia: Could the nurse call…?

exercises.context: En el hotel necesitas otra almohada. Llamas a recepción.
options: Could I have another pillow, please?
exercises.answer: Could I have another pillow, please?
exercises.why: Could I have…, please? es la forma amable de pedir algo.
En could no suena la l: «cud». En cold sí suena, y la o es «ou»: «cóuld».
Sube un poco la voz al final para sonar amable.

dialog.title: Un favor a la vecina
dialog.setting: Yolanda está de viaje y llama a su vecina inglesa, Margaret, para pedirle un favor

lines.t: Hi Margaret, it's Yolanda. Could you do me a favour?
lines.es: Hola, Margaret, soy Yolanda. ¿Me podrías hacer un favor?

lines.t: Could you water my plants on Wednesday?
Sure. Could I get the key from your son?
lines.es: Claro. ¿Puedo pedirle la llave a tu hijo?

lines.t: Yes, of course. He's got a spare key.
lines.es: Sí, claro. Él tiene una copia de la llave.

lines.t: Perfect. Could you send me his number?
I'll text it to you now. Thank you so much!
lines.es: Te lo mando ahora por mensaje. ¡Muchísimas gracias!
No hay de qué. ¡Disfruta del viaje!

options: Que le den de comer al gato

realLife.t: Could you do me a favour?
realLife.context: Para pedir ayuda a una amiga o una vecina

summary: Could you + verbo…? = pedir un favor; Could I + verbo…? = pedir permiso
Sin to y sin -s: Could she call me?
Contestar: Of course / Sure · I'm sorry, I can't
